'''Guerrerite''' was a valuable [[Ore/Legends|ore]] found in large quantities on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoszh Iszhir]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The ore could be turned into a [[Color/Legends|dark gray]] metal that was used to create technological items. Due to the high value of guerrerite and other metals on Hoszh Iszhir, the native [[Gektl]] [[Species/Legends|species]] had a [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]] network to protect them from theft. However, [[Stafuv Rahz]], the Gektl responsible for maintaining the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]], let the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] take over in exchange for control over his people, who were subsequently [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] to [[Mining/Legends|mine]] the ores on the planet.

==Description==
A valuable [[Ore/Legends|ore]] found<ref name="Aliens" /> on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoszh Iszhir]],<ref name="Aliens" /> guerrerite could be processed into a metal that was dark gray in [[Color/Legends|color]].<ref name="CWA" />

==History==
Guerrerite was found in large quantities on Hoszh Iszhir, the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Gektl]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Aliens" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the valuable material was used in the construction of various technological items.<ref name="CWA" /> During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], on Hoszh Iszhir, guerrerite and other precious metals were protected from theft by a [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]] network owned by the Gektl. The maintainer of the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]], a Gektl named [[Stafuv Rahz]], gave the codes to the shield to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in exchange for control over the Gektl species. The Empire sent a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] to [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombard]] the world, and the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] gave Rahz a commission in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] as well as control over the planets in the [[Gekto system|system]]. Under Rahz's control,<ref name="Aliens" /> the Empire took over the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|61|Hoszh Iszhir}}</ref> and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] the rest of the Gektls to mine the guerrerite and other ores<ref name="Aliens" /> for the profit of the Empire.<ref name="TCSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Guerrerite was first mentioned in the second part of "[[Aliens in the Empire]]," a [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] exclusive written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Rich Handley]] that was posted on [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 4]], [[2007]].<ref name="Aliens" /> In [[2013]], guerrerite was added as a common crafting material in [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']], an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] produced by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment.<ref name="CWA" />
